doc.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25

title: Freddie Keppard, known only by reputation
summary: She knew of Keppard as a good cornet player around Chicago but not personally.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Before the tape machine was on, you mentioned this fella, Kepler?
Freddie? Freddie Kepler. Well, I didn't know of any band he had. I just know that he played good connect, and I know he used to play around Chicago. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh.
But you didn't know him personally?
I just knew of him, not no close associates. I just know he played around Chicago.
